entries.title: Proverbs 23:1
segments: ¶When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what [is] before thee:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:2
segments: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou [be] a man given to appetite.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:3
segments: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they [are] deceitful meat.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:4
segments: ¶Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:5
segments: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for [riches] certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven. {set...: Heb. cause thine eyes to fly upon}

words.text: upon that which is not? for [riches] certainly
. {set...: Heb. cause thine eyes to fly upon}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:6
segments: ¶Eat thou not the bread of [him that hath] an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:

entries.title: Proverbs 23:7
segments: For as he thinketh in his heart, so [is] he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart [is] not with thee.

words.text: he to thee; but his heart

entries.title: Proverbs 23:8
segments: The morsel [which] thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:9
segments: ¶Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:10
segments: ¶Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless: {landmark: or, bound}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:11
segments: For their redeemer [is] mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:12
segments: ¶Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:13
segments: Withhold not correction from the child: for [if] thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:14
segments: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:15
segments: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine. {even...: or, even I will rejoice}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:16
segments: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:17
segments: ¶Let not thine heart envy sinners: but [be thou] in the fear of the LORD all the day long.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:18
segments: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off. {end: or, reward}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:19
segments: ¶Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:20
segments: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: {of flesh: Heb. of their flesh}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:21
segments: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe [a man] with rags.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:22
segments: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:23
segments: Buy the truth, and sell [it] not; [also] wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:24
segments: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise [child] shall have joy of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:25
segments: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:26
segments: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:27
segments: For a whore [is] a deep ditch; and a strange woman [is] a narrow pit.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:28
segments: She also lieth in wait as [for] a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men. {as for...: or, as a robber}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:29
segments: ¶Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

entries.title: Proverbs 23:30
segments: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:31
segments: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, [when] it moveth itself aright.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:32
segments: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder. {an...: or, a cockatrice}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:33
segments: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

entries.title: Proverbs 23:34
segments: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast. {the midst...: Heb. the heart of the sea}

words.text: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down
. {the midst...: Heb. the heart of the sea}

entries.title: Proverbs 23:35
segments: They have stricken me, [shalt thou say, and] I was not sick; they have beaten me, [and] I felt [it] not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again. {I felt...: Heb. I knew it not}

words.text: me, [shalt thou say, and] I was not sick
again. {I felt...: Heb. I knew it not}
